title: Episode Summary
description: Result of the `episodeSummary` tool (spec section 5.6): cumulative episode metrics. The tool takes no arguments. Orchestrators treat episodeSummary calls as episode delimiters for trajectory consolidation and lesson synthesis.

TotalReward.description: Sum of step rewards over the episode so far

StepCount.description: Number of steps executed this episode

RewardBreakdown.description: Cumulative reward per component, keyed by component name declared in the manifest
